main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Reverse the map ✝️ to awaken ❤️: you are asleep 🧠 in an illusion ┻
header_desc: The universe has a Universal Consciousness, timeless and spaceless: the ONE or <q>Invisible Father</q>, whose guidance —followed with the heart— frees us from the illusion of the Demiurge. Thus, the origin of the cosmos resides in the right hemisphere, the pneuma, open to the timeless and divine; while the left, the psyche, ties us to the temporal, to matter, and to the end of existence. The union of the Condor and the Eagle symbolizes the integration of science and spirituality, demonstrating that the divine spark is an inalienable essence to every human being.
left_title: The Return of Sophia: From Yaldabaoth's Prison to the Realm of Light
left_body: The Gnostic gospels, written nearly two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity, demonstrating that human existence transcends both matter and space-time. In this framework, consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ ❤️ and the material |EGO⟩ 🧠. This grants us a free perception will that can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE|EGO⟩. In general relativity, matter tells space-time how to curve and space-time tells matter how to move. Similarly, the ego exerts its own gravity: its density deforms your inner fabric and weaves the temporal and material illusion of the psyche 🧠. Thus, only through the wisdom of Sophia is it possible to understand that the phrase “the Father and I are one” is a call to dissolve the “false self” to return to the Realm of pure light where the Invisible Father dwells: the timeless and divine reality of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation, frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides in the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is inside you and outside you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3). Pistis Sophia represents the right hemisphere (the origin of the universe), while the demiurge Yaldabaoth embodies the left (the end of the universe), thus revealing the duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us towards a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: The ego and ignorance are diseases of consciousness that cause spiritual blindness and trigger illusion; therefore, each soul is free to decide whether to break the chains of its own demiurge or remain bound to it. For only when the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, will Mother Earth awaken, and humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The flight of science and spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and framework of integration: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancient knowledge, and the spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and the mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's rupture of simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The Faggin--Segarra conceptual ensemble: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The Nag Hammadi discovery (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home, but as the soul's confinement. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas, but to liberate the inner spark from the Demiurge's prison through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Realm of Light and the Demiurge's Prison (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, a self-centered god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the ego's cognitive prison, versus Jesus' revolutionary message dismantling the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The end, the great paradox, boils down to this: in the vastness of the cosmos —with its more than two trillion galaxies— it is there where the phrase of Jesus resonates most strongly: “The Father and I are one”. Could this have had a hidden message about the deep bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a tall white man with a flowing beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly there is such a God. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity</q>
